name: Dragonsgate
subtitle: The city between two shores
description: Follow the tide through a walled island, crowded quays and the neighborhoods across the channel. Every door has a story.
credit: Map supplied by the curator. Location names and stories are fictional additions.

overrides.name: The Dragonseat
overrides.description: A basalt keep built around the rib bones of an ancient sea dragon. The city council meets beneath a ceiling stained by centuries of torch smoke.
overrides.person: Lady Maren Voss, keeper of the city seal
overrides.rumor: A sealed stair beneath the council chamber is warm even in winter.

overrides.name: The Ninefold Archive
overrides.description: Nine reading rooms surround a locked courtyard. Copyists preserve shipping contracts, family trees and maps with conspicuous blank spaces.
overrides.person: Archivist Pell, who remembers every overdue book
overrides.rumor: A surveyor returned a map showing a street that does not exist yet.

overrides.name: Shrine of the First Flame
overrides.description: A black-roofed sanctuary keeps a blue flame burning in a shallow bronze bowl. Sailors leave small clay boats at its steps.
overrides.rumor: The flame bends toward the harbor whenever an unregistered ship arrives.

overrides.name: The Astronomer’s Stair
overrides.description: A narrow stair climbs above the northern roofs to a brass telescope and a platform open to the wind.
overrides.person: Orren Vale, astronomer without a guild
overrides.rumor: Last night a familiar star appeared twice.

overrides.name: Saint Orla’s House
overrides.description: A quiet hospice offers broth, clean beds and a place to mend. No visitor is asked which banner they serve.
overrides.person: Brother Fen, herbalist and patient listener
overrides.rumor: A patient keeps drawing the same door while asleep.

overrides.name: Northwatch Beacon
overrides.description: The northernmost tower raises a green lantern when the channel is clear. Its keepers measure the tides against marks cut into the stone.
overrides.rumor: Someone has been moving the oldest tide mark.

overrides.name: The Brass Heron
overrides.description: An upstairs tavern where dock pilots trade news over peppered mussels and dark beer. The windows face the busiest approach to the quays.
overrides.rumor: A pilot was paid to guide a ship with no crew and no wake.

overrides.name: Harbormaster’s Hall
overrides.description: Cargo tags hang from rafters above a long counter. Every berth, bonded crate and overdue vessel passes through this office.
overrides.rumor: Three ships with different names are using the same registration seal.

overrides.name: Gullhook Pier
overrides.description: A crooked timber pier serves the small coastal traders. Crates of salt fish compete for room with baskets of bright blue crabs.
overrides.rumor: A crate has been ticking since the last low tide.

overrides.name: The Salt Exchange
overrides.description: Merchants weigh sea salt, lamp oil and cured fish beneath a whitewashed arcade. Deals are agreed with a pinch of salt on the tongue.
overrides.rumor: A merchant will pay handsomely for salt that has never touched the sea.

overrides.name: The Chainhouse
overrides.description: A capstan house controls the great harbor chain. Its iron links are wide enough for a child to crawl through.
overrides.rumor: Someone opens the chain for seven minutes on moonless nights.

overrides.name: The Gilded Compass
overrides.description: A cramped shop sells charts, compasses and little glass globes of captured fog. The owner corrects every map before selling it.
overrides.rumor: A customer wants a chart of the city as it stood three centuries ago.

overrides.name: Bellfounder’s Yard
overrides.description: Bronze bells cool in sand pits beside the foundry. Each bell is tested at dusk, filling nearby lanes with clashing notes.
overrides.rumor: A bell cast yesterday rings when no one touches it.

overrides.name: The Crooked Crown
overrides.description: Low beams and an enormous hearth make this old inn a favorite of messengers. The best table is reserved for someone who has never arrived.
overrides.rumor: A messenger left a letter addressed to the next person who sits by the fire.

overrides.name: The Ink & Thorn
overrides.description: A stationer and bookbinder selling weatherproof journals, sealing wax and politely forbidden histories.
overrides.rumor: A bound diary adds one sentence to itself every dawn.

overrides.name: Mercy Bell Chapel
overrides.description: A small neighborhood chapel keeps its door open through the night. Neighbors ring the hand bell to ask for help.
overrides.rumor: The hand bell rang underwater during the last storm.

overrides.name: Tanners’ Court
overrides.description: Leather awnings shade a courtyard of vats and drying hides. The workers make the strongest sail harnesses in Dragonsgate.
overrides.rumor: A hide delivered from upriver cannot be cut with steel.

overrides.name: The Moonlit Eel
overrides.description: A blue lantern marks a tavern popular with actors, night watchmen and people waiting for discreet introductions.
overrides.rumor: A masked guest buys two drinks each night and pours one into the hearth.

overrides.name: Lantern Market
overrides.description: A knot of stalls sells spiced sweets, paper lanterns and small household charms well after sunset.
overrides.rumor: Every lantern made by one vendor shows the same unfamiliar face.

overrides.name: The Weavers’ Hall
overrides.description: Colored wool hangs across a long hall where apprentices compete to weave the finest tide-blue cloth.
overrides.rumor: A bolt of cloth unravels into a map when left in moonlight.

overrides.name: The Southwater Baths
overrides.description: Warm pools occupy a grand building near the southern wall. Mosaic sea creatures curl beneath the water.
overrides.rumor: A locked pool fills with fresh water though it has no inlet.

overrides.name: Warden’s Rest
overrides.description: An outlying watchtower guards the southern approach to the island. A narrow landing admits one boat at a time.
overrides.rumor: The watch has heard knocks from below the tower’s foundation.

overrides.name: The Western Teeth
overrides.description: A squat stone outpost watches the western channel. Its signal shutters are patched with mismatched planks.
overrides.rumor: A signal from the abandoned tower was answered last night.

overrides.name: Smuggler’s Candle
overrides.description: A tiny island alehouse offers shelter to ferrymen and late arrivals. The cellar is considerably larger than the room above it.
overrides.person: Old Kett, who claims to own the island
overrides.rumor: A cellar stair is only visible at the lowest tide.

overrides.name: The Tide Oracle
overrides.description: A solitary shrine keeps bowls of seawater on stone shelves. Petitioners read their fortunes in the sediment left behind.
overrides.rumor: A bowl filled at high tide contained a tiny iron key.

overrides.name: Eastern Signal House
overrides.description: Two small watch buildings stand above a short pier. Their flags warn larger ships away from the outer rocks.
overrides.rumor: An extra flag appears in the rack whenever fog rolls in.

overrides.name: The Drowned Saint
overrides.description: A weathered island chapel honors those lost at sea. Boatmen tie ribbons to its iron fence.
overrides.rumor: One ribbon has remained dry through a week of rain.

overrides.name: Westgate Custom House
overrides.description: Incoming river cargo is weighed and taxed at a row of broad tables. Clerks stamp everything from barley sacks to live geese.
overrides.rumor: A crate that passed inspection yesterday weighs twice as much today.

overrides.name: The Long Wharf
overrides.description: A crowded finger of piers reaches into the channel. Coasters from half a dozen ports unload alongside local fishing boats.
overrides.rumor: A boat tied here has a different cargo every morning.

overrides.name: The Copper Kettle
overrides.description: Breakfast starts before dawn at this busy coaching inn. The kitchen serves oat cakes and a stew that never quite leaves the fire.
overrides.rumor: A regular guest pays with coins minted next year.

overrides.name: The Grain Steps
overrides.description: Grain sellers stack sacks under striped awnings beside the old western road. Small hand mills grind flour to order.
overrides.rumor: Someone has been buying every sack from a particular field.

overrides.name: The Open Hand
overrides.description: Carters, porters and laborers gather at a broad guildhall to find work and settle disputes.
overrides.rumor: A porter was hired to move a locked chest that begged not to be delivered.

overrides.name: The Roundhouse Theatre
overrides.description: An oval playhouse stages comedies by day and ambitious tragedies after dark. Street vendors gather outside for the interval.
overrides.rumor: The leading actor’s reflection has started rehearsing a different play.

overrides.name: Morrow’s Forge
overrides.description: A smith makes ship nails, locks and finely balanced knives in a shop blackened by generations of smoke.
overrides.rumor: A customer left a sword that is heavier when someone lies nearby.

overrides.name: The Red Thread
overrides.description: A clothier repairs work clothes downstairs and tailors extravagant coats upstairs. Measurements are kept in a book with a red clasp.
overrides.rumor: A coat returned for repair has a pocket that was never sewn into it.

overrides.name: The Pilots’ Hearth
overrides.description: River pilots meet beneath painted beams to exchange charts and assign the next day’s passages.
overrides.rumor: A newly exposed sandbar bears the foundations of a house.

overrides.name: The Black Gull
overrides.description: A sailors’ tavern leans over the water on oak piles. The dice tables are honest, according to the owner.
overrides.rumor: Someone is offering passage aboard a ship that sank ten years ago.

overrides.name: Seven Sails Shipwrights
overrides.description: Sawhorses and timber cradles fill a busy waterfront yard. A half-built cutter sits beneath a patchwork canvas roof.
overrides.rumor: The newest hull hums when the tide turns.

overrides.name: The Ropewalk
overrides.description: Long narrow sheds produce rope for fishing boats and ocean traders. Apprentices race along the twisting lanes of hemp.
overrides.rumor: A finished coil keeps tying itself into the same knot.

overrides.name: The Pearl Ledger
overrides.description: An appraiser buys pearls, coral and curiosities brought up by local divers. Every purchase is recorded in green ink.
overrides.rumor: A diver found a pearl with a tiny moving shadow inside.

overrides.name: The Eastwater Lock
overrides.description: Lock gates regulate the narrow eastern waterway. Children line the rail to watch barges rise with the incoming tide.
overrides.rumor: Something large brushes the lower gate at midnight.

overrides.name: The Blue Door Apothecary
overrides.description: Dried herbs fill jars behind a deep blue door. The owner makes remedies for seasickness and unusually vivid dreams.
overrides.rumor: A dream remedy is causing different patients to meet in the same place.

overrides.name: Eastbank Watchhouse
overrides.description: A square watchhouse stands at the bend in the eastern road. Its courtyard is always full of confiscated handcarts.
overrides.rumor: Every night someone moves one of the confiscated carts outside the gate.

overrides.name: The Quiet Oar
overrides.description: A modest waterside inn rents clean rooms and rowing boats. Guests leave before sunrise to fish the eastern reaches.
overrides.rumor: One rented boat came back with an extra set of wet footprints.

overrides.name: The Greenward Glassworks
overrides.description: Three furnace halls glow beside the southern wall. Their glass floats are sold to fishing fleets across the coast.
overrides.rumor: A batch of green glass shows a harbor with no ships in it.

overrides.name: The Laurel Court
overrides.description: An enclosed triangular garden offers shade between the southern lanes. Neighbors play tiles on worn stone tables.
overrides.rumor: A tree in the garden blossoms only when someone makes a promise.

overrides.name: The Herb Garden
overrides.description: A walled kitchen garden supplies rare greens and medicinal roots to the city. Visitors may buy cuttings at the gate.
overrides.rumor: The oldest root bed is growing around a buried brass lid.

overrides.name: The Southern Gate
overrides.description: A broad gate opens onto the field roads. A worn dragon above the arch has had its missing tooth replaced with copper.
overrides.rumor: Travelers have started leaving teeth beneath the arch.

overrides.name: The Last Lantern
overrides.description: A roadside inn offers a final hot meal before the city. Its stable is larger than its common room.
overrides.rumor: A traveler left a horse that knows how to open every latch.

overrides.name: Orchard House
overrides.description: An old farmhouse stands beyond the southern walls among neatly tended fruit trees. A cider press works through the harvest.
overrides.rumor: A tree planted this spring already bears fruit with silver seeds.

overrides.name: The Old Mill Road
overrides.description: A cluster of cottages marks a crossroads used by farmers bringing produce to market. The milestone has been turned around.
overrides.rumor: All four faces of the milestone now point toward Dragonsgate.

overrides.name: The Stone & Scale
overrides.description: A mason sells carved signs, hearthstones and tiny stone dragons. Samples crowd every surface of the workshop.
overrides.rumor: A small carved dragon has been found facing a different direction each morning.

overrides.name: The Amber Window
overrides.description: A retired navigator keeps a house with amber panes and a rooftop full of wind vanes.
overrides.rumor: The wind vanes have begun pointing toward a single house inland.

overrides.name: The Ferry Bell
overrides.description: A bell at the end of the long quay summons the cross-channel ferry. Its timetable follows the tides rather than the clock.
overrides.rumor: A passenger has been waiting here since before the ferrier was born.
